newsitem.title: UK: EBRD raises 8.95 bln ESP via IBEX-35 linked bonds.
newsitem.headline: EBRD raises 8.95 bln ESP via IBEX-35 linked bonds.

text.p: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development has issued a 8.95 billion peseta seven-tranche bond issue whose redemption value will be linked to the IBEX-35 stock market index, lead manager Santander Investment said.
Denominations are 100,000 pesetas and the listing is AIAF.

AMT 833.334 MLN ESP COUPON 4.30 MATURITY 20.DEC.00
TYPE STRAIGHT ISS PRICE 100.10 PAY DATE 17.APR.97
